title_short: Keith McArthur · AYH · A Dad, a Diagnosis, a Foundation
headline: Keith's story in order: a 10-year search for his son's diagnosis, six other families, a foundation, and a seat across from the drug company. He is happy because of his family.
story: Keith's son Bryson has GRIN1 disorder. The diagnosis took almost 10 years. Keith asked if Bryson would die from it. Bryson is 20 and depends on the people around him for almost everything.
Keith found a Facebook group with six other families; his was the seventh. Now there are hundreds. GRIN1 parents launched a foundation for all four GRIN gene disorders.
Today he sits with GRIN Therapeutics to help get more patients into the trial. Asked if he is happy, he says yes. The source: his family.
do: Hook on C5194 “And ours was long… almost 10 years old”, the TV photo of Bryson over Keith.
Then the story in order: intro, the question, dependence, seventh family, the foundation, today.
Name super on his first sync (00:05).
Button: Nick asks “Are you happy?”, “I'm happy”, “My family.” Hold a live beat.
dont: Don't open on the same hook bite as “The Seventh Family”, “Blue Glasses for Carter” or “A Different View”.
Don't use the end of IMG_5660 (“I don't know, man. Let's do this later. I'm tired.”).
Not a pharma or trial explainer. That's the hero film.
No “cure is near”. Hopeful, never pity.
